BearPaw_Description.english: The selling price of blackberries and salmonberries rises to 3 times the original.

BlessingOfFriendship_description.chinese: 你与人交谈时可以增进更多友谊。
BlessingOfFriendship_description.english: When you talk with people you can increase more friendship.

BlessingOfTheButterfly_description.chinese: 山谷某处有一只五彩蝴蝶等待着你……
BlessingOfTheButterfly_description.english: Somewhere in the valley there is a multicolored butterfly waiting for you...

BlessingOfWaters_description.chinese: 你今天钓前三条鱼时会更轻松。（还有 {0} 条）
BlessingOfWaters_description.english: When you catch the first three fish today it will be easier. ({0} left)

BooksellerInTown.english: The book stall owner is in town today.

BroccoliFusilli_Description.chinese: 放了西蓝花和番茄干的美味意大利面。
BroccoliFusilli_Description.english: Delicious Italian pasta with broccoli and dried tomatoes put in.

ButterflyPowder_Question.chinese: 你确定吗？{0}被驱逐出农场之后就永远不会回来了。
ButterflyPowder_Question.english: Are you sure? After {0} is driven off the farm it will never come back.

CactusMan_Closed.chinese: 仙人掌商人：它们现在有点害羞，晚点再来吧。
CactusMan_Closed.english: Cactus merchant: They're a bit shy now, come again later.

CactusMan_Collected.chinese: 仙人掌商人：小家伙怎么样了？
CactusMan_Collected.english: Cactus merchant: How is the little fellow doing?

CactusMan_Intro_1.chinese: 仙人掌商人：很好……你看起来会喜欢我给你的东西。
CactusMan_Intro_1.english: Cactus merchant: Very good... You look like you'll like what I give you.

CactusMan_Intro_2.chinese: 仙人掌商人：嗯……我正好有最适合你的那个。
CactusMan_Intro_2.english: Cactus merchant: Mm... I happen to have the one that suits you best.

CactusMan_Intro_3.chinese: 仙人掌商人：你的眼神……就像在说：“快给我仙人掌，不然我就要爆炸了。”
CactusMan_Intro_3.english: Cactus merchant: Your look... it's like saying: "Quick, give me a cactus, or else I'm going to explode."

CactusMan_No.chinese: 仙人掌商人：我明白。仙人掌虽然很小，但迎接它的到来就要承担很多责任。等你准备好再回来吧。
CactusMan_No.english: Cactus merchant: I understand. Although a cactus is small, welcoming its arrival means taking on a lot of responsibility. Come back when you're ready.

CactusMan_Question.chinese: 仙人掌商人：你准备好迎接一株新的仙人掌的到来了吗？
CactusMan_Question.english: Cactus merchant: Are you ready to welcome the arrival of a new cactus?

CactusMan_Yes_1.chinese: 仙人掌商人：嗯，它和你长得实在太像了，你不觉得吗？
CactusMan_Yes_1.english: Cactus merchant: Mm, it looks really too much like you, don't you think?

CactusMan_Yes_2.chinese: 仙人掌商人：它有点害羞，但我相信你们很快就会成为朋友。
CactusMan_Yes_2.english: Cactus merchant: It's a bit shy, but I believe you'll become friends very soon.

CactusMan_Yes_3.chinese: 仙人掌商人：太好了……简直是天作之合。
CactusMan_Yes_3.english: Cactus merchant: Wonderful... simply a match made in heaven.

CactusMan_Yes_4.chinese: 仙人掌商人：这一株最适合你……理由不便透露。
CactusMan_Yes_4.english: Cactus merchant: This one suits you best... the reason isn't convenient to reveal.

CactusMan_Yes_5.chinese: 仙人掌商人：这一株看起来有点奇怪，但很适合你。
CactusMan_Yes_5.english: Cactus merchant: This one looks a bit strange, but it suits you well.

CactusMan_Yes_Full.chinese: 仙人掌商人：你的空间不够……腾出空间之后再来吧。
CactusMan_Yes_Full.english: Cactus merchant: You don't have enough space... come again after clearing some space.

CactusMan_Yes_Intro.chinese: 仙人掌商人：很好。我来看看……
CactusMan_Yes_Intro.english: Cactus merchant: Very good. Let me have a look...

Cook_ChoseIngredient.chinese: 厨师：非常好……你选了{0}，非常棒。来……你要什么酱？
Cook_ChoseIngredient.english: Chef: Very good... you chose {0}, excellent. Now... what sauce do you want?

Cook_ChoseSauce.chinese: 厨师：非常好，浇上健康的{0}，让菜肴更加美味。
Cook_ChoseSauce.english: Chef: Very good, pour on healthy {0}, to make the dish more delicious.

Cook_Done.chinese: 厨师：做好啦！名字就叫，“{0}”。请享用！
Cook_Done.english: Chef: It's done! Its name is "{0}". Please enjoy!

Cook_Intro.english: Chef: Hello there... are you hungry or not?

Cook_Intro_No.chinese: 厨师：真遗憾，等你准备好吃顿大餐的时候再回来吧。
Cook_Intro_No.english: Chef: What a pity, come back when you're ready to eat a big meal.

Cook_Intro_Yes.chinese: 厨师：哇……那实在太好了。（咂嘴）
Cook_Intro_Yes.english: Chef: Wow... that's really too good. (smacks lips)

Cook_Intro_Yes2.chinese: 厨师：我想为你做一道非常特别的、量身定制的菜，怎么样？
Cook_Intro_Yes2.english: Chef: I'd like to make you a very special, tailor-made dish, how about it?

Cook_Intro_Yes3.chinese: 厨师：哦哦哦……呵呵……非常好。来吧……你想吃什么？
Cook_Intro_Yes3.english: Chef: Oh oh oh... heh heh... very good. Come on... what do you want to eat?

CursedMannequin_Description.chinese: 可以随意打扮它。记得祈祷它不会在你睡觉的时候活过来……
CursedMannequin_Description.english: You can dress it up as you like. Remember to pray that it won't come alive while you're sleeping...

DF_Mine_CalicoStatue_Description_5.chinese: 晕倒后掉落的三花蛋增多
DF_Mine_CalicoStatue_Description_5.english: Calico eggs dropped after fainting increase

DF_Mine_CalicoStatue_MP_Message.chinese: 卡利科三花雕像：“{0}”已激活。
DF_Mine_CalicoStatue_MP_Message.english: Calico tri-color statue: "{0}" has been activated.

DF_Mine_Explanation.chinese: ——欢迎参加骷髅洞穴挑战！——^^洞穴各处出现了卡利科三花蛋和神秘的卡利科三花雕像。^
DF_Mine_Explanation.english: -- Welcome to the Skull Cavern challenge! -- Calico eggs and mysterious calico statues have appeared all over the cavern.

DF_Mine_Explanation_2.chinese: 找到卡利科三花蛋的概率取决于你的“三花蛋分数”。^^每下降 5 层或者激活一座卡利科三花雕像，你就会获得“三花蛋分数”。^
DF_Mine_Explanation_2.english: The probability of finding calico eggs depends on your "calico egg score". Every time you go down 5 floors or activate a calico statue, you get "calico egg score".

DF_Mine_Explanation_3.chinese: ……但是要小心！卡利科三花雕像还会产生各种奇怪和危险的效果！^^获得较高的“三花蛋分数”时，可以找吉尔领取奖励。^
DF_Mine_Explanation_3.english: ...But be careful! The calico statues also produce all kinds of strange and dangerous effects! When you get a fairly high "calico egg score", you can go to Gil to collect a reward.

DeluxeCheesePress_Description.chinese: 可以同时加工 3 壶牛奶。
DeluxeCheesePress_Description.english: Can process 3 jugs of milk at the same time.

DeluxeCrabPot_description.chinese: 能比普通蟹笼捕到更多东西。
DeluxeCrabPot_description.english: Can catch more things than an ordinary crab pot.

DeluxeLoom_Description.chinese: 可以同时加工 3 团动物毛。
DeluxeLoom_Description.english: Can process 3 balls of animal hair at the same time.

DeluxeMayoMachine_Description.chinese: 可以同时加工 3 个蛋。
DeluxeMayoMachine_Description.english: Can process 3 eggs at the same time.

DesertFestival_Abigail.chinese: 谢谢你修好了巴士！坐巴士很快乐。$h#$e#我一直想去鹈鹕镇外面旅行。
DesertFestival_Abigail.english: Thanks for fixing the bus! Riding the bus is so fun. I've always wanted to travel outside Pelican Town.

DesertFestival_Abigail_marriage.chinese: 我本来想跟你一起去骷髅洞穴，但是现在看到了那边的小吃摊……#$e#你先走吧，不用等我……路上小心点！
DesertFestival_Abigail_marriage.english: I originally wanted to go to the Skull Cavern with you, but then I saw the snack stand over there... You go first, no need to wait for me... be careful on the way!

DesertFestival_Alex.chinese: 这些卡利科三花蛋也太大了吧！#$b#满满的蛋白质……
DesertFestival_Alex.english: These calico eggs are way too big! Full of protein...

DesertFestival_Alex_marriage.chinese: 哎……你在沙漠的阳光下看起来真可爱……$h
DesertFestival_Alex_marriage.english: Hey... you look really cute in the desert sunshine...

DesertFestival_Caroline.chinese: 天气真是太好了，我感觉要融化在空气里了。$h
DesertFestival_Caroline.english: The weather is really so good, I feel like I'm melting into the air.

DesertFestival_Clint.chinese: 哎，@，说句实话，我不太喜欢节日。#$b#但假如我待在家里，想到其他人都在外面玩得很开心，我会感觉更糟。$s
DesertFestival_Clint.english: Hey, @, to tell the truth, I don't much like festivals. But if I stayed at home, thinking of everyone else out having fun, I'd feel worse.

DesertFestival_Demetrius.chinese: 为什么人会喜欢吃辣的东西？从生物学的角度来看，这是违反直觉的。#$e#难道有什么我没想到的……$5
DesertFestival_Demetrius.english: Why do people like eating spicy things? From the angle of biology, this goes against intuition. Could there be something I haven't thought of...

DesertFestival_Elliott.chinese: （喃喃自语）……唔，用脚趾感觉像牛奶，但比较粘稠，不过还是比家那边的更丝滑……#$b#啊，不好意思！我快要变成沙子鉴赏家了。$h
DesertFestival_Elliott.english: (muttering to himself) ...Mm, with the toes it feels like milk, but more viscous, though still silkier than the one back home... Ah, excuse me! I'm about to become a sand connoisseur.

DesertFestival_Elliott_marriage.chinese: 哎呦喂，快来看！好漂亮的沙漠玫瑰！$h#$e#亲爱的，记得保持水分哦。
DesertFestival_Elliott_marriage.english: Oh my, come look quick! What a beautiful desert rose! Darling, remember to stay hydrated.

DesertFestival_Emily.chinese: 唔……我能感受到，你的穿搭不太符合你的内心。走到这个箱子里面，我们让你焕然一新！
DesertFestival_Emily.english: Mm... I can sense your outfit doesn't quite fit your inner self. Walk into this box, and we'll give you a brand-new look!

DesertFestival_Emily2_marriage.chinese: 我玩得很开心，但是太忙了，还没来得及做家务。你也开心点！
DesertFestival_Emily2_marriage.english: I'm having a lot of fun, but I'm too busy, I haven't had time to do housework yet. You be happy too!

DesertFestival_Emily3_marriage.chinese: 今天早上我喂鹦鹉了吗？记不清了……
DesertFestival_Emily3_marriage.english: Did I feed the parrot this morning? I can't remember clearly...

DesertFestival_Emily_marriage.chinese: @！你现在这样挺好看的……不过你也可以考虑到箱子里来试试！
DesertFestival_Emily_marriage.english: @! You look quite nice as you are now... but you could also consider coming into the box to try!

DesertFestival_George.chinese: 她在嘀咕什么？我就想去那个帐篷吃点辣的东西！
DesertFestival_George.english: What is she muttering? I just want to go to that tent to eat something spicy!

DesertFestival_Gus.chinese: 平时镇上举办节日的时候，吃的全都是我准备的，不过今天我就乐得清闲了！$h
DesertFestival_Gus.english: Usually when the town holds a festival, the food is all prepared by me, but today I'm happy to take it easy!

DesertFestival_Haley.chinese: 你是不是闻到香味了？是我在身上抹的椰子油。#$b#我要全力以赴体验沙漠风情！$h
DesertFestival_Haley.english: Do you smell a fragrance? It's the coconut oil I rubbed on my body. I'm going all out to experience the desert atmosphere!

DesertFestival_Haley2.english: Haley is sparkling in the sunshine.

DesertFestival_Haley2_marriage.english: Your wife is taking a nap.

DesertFestival_Harvey.chinese: 进入洞穴可能非常危险。我希望不要发生意外，不过……以防万一我还是待在这里吧。#$e#作为医生，我建议你尽量少接触满是飞蛇的洞穴！不过你硬要去我也拦不住你。
DesertFestival_Harvey.english: Going into the cavern can be very dangerous. I hope no accidents happen, but... just in case I'll stay here. As a doctor, I advise you to minimize contact with caverns full of flying serpents! But if you insist on going I can't stop you.

DesertFestival_Harvey_marriage.chinese: @，因为节日我会工作到很晚，晚上就不用等我了！#$e#答应我，在骷髅洞穴里一定要小心。
DesertFestival_Harvey_marriage.english: @, because of the festival I'll work until very late, so don't wait for me at night! Promise me you'll definitely be careful in the Skull Cavern.

DesertFestival_Jas.chinese: 我很开心，但要是能吃冰淇淋就更好了……
DesertFestival_Jas.english: I'm very happy, but if I could eat ice cream it would be even better...

DesertFestival_Jodi.chinese: 啊，不用管我，我就买点东西。#$e#我在找最适合家里客厅的装饰品，要是不好好逛商店可能会错过！
DesertFestival_Jodi.english: Ah, don't mind me, I'm just buying some things. I'm looking for the decoration that best suits the living room at home; if I don't properly browse the shops I might miss it!

DesertFestival_Kent.chinese: 哎，@，你喜欢这种炎热的天气吗？
DesertFestival_Kent.english: Hey, @, do you like this kind of hot weather?

DesertFestival_Leah.chinese: 我在想……假如我没有住在星露谷而是住在这里，我会画出不一样的画吗？
DesertFestival_Leah.english: I'm thinking... if I didn't live in Stardew Valley but lived here, would I paint different paintings?

DesertFestival_Leah_marriage.chinese: 我想去游泳，但水里面好像全是蝎鲤鱼！$h
DesertFestival_Leah_marriage.english: I want to go swimming, but the water seems to be full of scorpion carp!

DesertFestival_Leo.chinese: 我喜欢这个地方，这儿的天气让我想起了家。
DesertFestival_Leo.english: I like this place, the weather here reminds me of home.

DesertFestival_Lewis.chinese: 度过漫长、黑暗的冬天之后，举办这么个节日能让大家重振精神。
DesertFestival_Lewis.english: After getting through a long, dark winter, holding a festival like this can let everyone revive their spirits.

DesertFestival_Lewis2.chinese: @，能来这里都是多亏你修好了巴士！实在太感谢你了。
DesertFestival_Lewis2.english: @, being able to come here is all thanks to you fixing the bus! Thank you so much.

DesertFestival_Lewis3.chinese: 别忘了，今天是节日的最后一天。不过我们明年还会回来的。
DesertFestival_Lewis3.english: Don't forget, today is the last day of the festival. But we'll come back again next year.

DesertFestival_Linus.chinese: 我搭了个顺风车，不过是扒在巴士的车底下。#$e#满满的卡利科沙漠风味，独此一家。嘿嘿……$h
DesertFestival_Linus.english: I hitched a free ride, but by clinging to the underside of the bus. Full of Calico Desert flavor, the only one of its kind. Heh heh...

segments.gloss: the only one of its kind

DesertFestival_Marnie.chinese: 哎，@，我在想动物奶的事情。#$e#你喝过骆驼奶吗？据说味道是咸的。
DesertFestival_Marnie.english: Hey, @, I'm thinking about the matter of animal milk. Have you drunk camel milk? It's said the taste is salty.

DesertFestival_Maru.chinese: 这些小选手训练有素，真了不起！$h
DesertFestival_Maru.english: These little contestants are well-trained, really amazing!

DesertFestival_Maru_marriage.chinese: 你的卡利科三花蛋收集得怎么样？有好多精美的奖品！$h#$e#我相信你能搞定的。
DesertFestival_Maru_marriage.english: How is your Calico egg collecting going? There are lots of exquisite prizes! I believe you can handle it.

DesertFestival_NowOpen.english: The Desert Festival has now already begun!

DesertFestival_Pam.chinese: 哎，孩子……你今天休息吗？偶尔放松一下也挺好的，是不是？#$e#对啊……即使是我这把老骨头偶尔也要晒晒太阳！在我晒干之前叫醒我就行……呵呵……
DesertFestival_Pam.english: Hey, kid... are you resting today? Relaxing a bit once in a while is quite good too, isn't it? Right... even this old bag of bones of mine needs to bask in the sun now and then! Just wake me before I dry out... heh heh...

DesertFestival_Penny.chinese: 几千年前，这片土地存在一个古代文明。不知道是什么样的呢？
DesertFestival_Penny.english: Several thousand years ago, an ancient civilization existed on this land. I wonder what it was like?

DesertFestival_Penny_marriage.chinese: 亲爱的，我就随便看看有没有适合买回家的东西。$h
DesertFestival_Penny_marriage.english: Dear, I'm just casually looking around to see whether there's anything suitable to buy for home.

DesertFestival_Pierre.chinese: 我觉得观察其他人开店很有意思，毕竟我也是店主。#$e#（悄悄地）我店里的货比桑迪的强太多了！别告诉她啊。
DesertFestival_Pierre.english: I find observing other people run shops very interesting, after all I'm a shopkeeper too. (Quietly) The goods in my shop are much better than Sandy's! Don't tell her.

DesertFestival_Robin.chinese: 哎，@，我们就是随便聊聊。这帮人虽然是我邻居，但是平时不常见到！
DesertFestival_Robin.english: Hey, @, we're just casually chatting. Although this bunch are my neighbors, I don't often see them usually!

DesertFestival_Sam.chinese: 哎，@，来看看我的仙人掌。我在想给它起什么名字比较好。#$e#唔……要么就叫“%name”？
DesertFestival_Sam.english: Hey, @, come look at my cactus. I'm thinking what name would be good to give it. Hmm... maybe just call it "%name"?

DesertFestival_Sam_marriage.chinese: 哎，别忘了在节日结束前去领我们的免费仙人掌。#$b#不管它长什么样，放在我们家肯定很合适！$h
DesertFestival_Sam_marriage.english: Hey, don't forget to go get our free cactus before the festival ends. No matter what it grows to look like, it'll definitely suit our home!

DesertFestival_Sandy.chinese: 这可能是我一年中最忙的时候了！能见到大家真好。
DesertFestival_Sandy.english: This is probably my busiest time of the year! Being able to see everyone is really nice.

DesertFestival_Sebastian.chinese: 你好，我在逗这只鸟，她好像很喜欢我。
DesertFestival_Sebastian.english: Hello, I'm playing with this bird, she seems to like me a lot.

DesertFestival_Sebastian_marriage.chinese: 哎，我就待在这儿，在阴凉处歇一会儿。#$e#你懂的……我一直是比较宅的人。$h
DesertFestival_Sebastian_marriage.english: Hey, I'll just stay here and rest a while in the shade. You know... I've always been more of a homebody.

DesertFestival_Shane.chinese: 我小时候来过一次……我就记得坐巴士的时候晕车了。
DesertFestival_Shane.english: I came once when I was little... I only remember getting carsick while riding the bus.

DesertFestival_Shane_marriage.chinese: 今晚记得提醒我刷牙……有十二种口味的汽水，我打算全部尝一遍。#$e#唔……山洞胡萝卜汽水……（咕嘟咕嘟）
DesertFestival_Shane_marriage.english: Remember to remind me to brush my teeth tonight... there are twelve flavors of soda, I plan to taste all of them once through. Mmm... cave carrot soda... (glug glug)

DesertFestival_Willy.chinese: 啊，暖和的天气里能闻到烤虾的味道就很满足。
DesertFestival_Willy.english: Ah, in warm weather, being able to smell grilled shrimp is very satisfying.

DriedFlowers_description.english: A bag of beautiful dried flowers.

DwarfStatue_1.chinese: 找到梯子和竖井的几率更高。
DwarfStatue_1.english: The chance of finding ladders and shafts is higher.

DwarfStatue_2.english: The chance of finding coal is higher.

DwarfStatue_4.english: The chance of finding geodes is higher.

EggShop_Closed.english: The shop isn't open, please come again later.

Fizz_Intro_1.chinese: 哦……看来你收到我的信了？你好你好。#$b#我叫菲兹，来自 Joja 特别服务部门。$h#$b#你是不是没听说过我们？没关系，大多数人都不知道……#$b#我们不像其他Joja产品有很多广告宣传。我们更像是为精英客户提供的“特别服务”。#$b#我们是干什么的呢？呵呵……这样说吧……我们专门处理“原则上很复杂”的事情……懂我意思不？#$b#闲聊也够了，我们谈正事吧。#$b#我听说你正在努力实现“完美”，多么伟大的目标！……但是很困难。极其困难。#$b#要做各种烹饪、打造、杀怪，还有复杂的交友……嚯！你压力不大就怪了。$s#$b#不过听好了……你的困难在我这里就迎刃而解了！我们可以轻松搞定。$h#$b#看到这些文件了吗？这是《完美豁免书》。#$b#每一张都代表了 1% 的完美度，多么美妙！而且还有齐先生的亲笔签名……绝对正版！#$b#我看起来像个骗子吗？？$u#$b#……$u#$b#谁让你回答了。#$b#……总之，我可以卖给你这种文件，价格非常诱人……每张只要 500,000 金。简直是白菜价！#$b#没事，不急的，你好好考虑一下！我等着你来……$h
Fizz_Intro_1.english: Oh... looks like you got my letter? Hello hello. I'm called Fizz, from the Joja Special Services Department. Is it that you haven't heard of us? No matter, most people don't know... We don't have lots of advertising like other Joja products. We're more like a "special service" provided for elite clients. What do we do? Heh heh... let's put it this way... we specialize in handling things that are "complicated in principle"... get my meaning? Enough chit-chat, let's talk business. I heard you're striving to achieve "perfection", what a great goal!... But it's hard. Extremely hard. All kinds of cooking, crafting, monster killing, and complicated friendships... whoa! It'd be strange if you weren't stressed. But listen up... with me, your difficulties are easily solved! We can handle it easily. See these documents? This is the "Perfection Waiver". Each sheet represents 1% of perfection, how wonderful! And it has Mr. Qi's own signature... absolutely genuine! Do I look like a swindler?? ... Who told you to answer. ... Anyway, I can sell you this kind of document at a very tempting price... only 500,000g per sheet. It's basically dirt cheap! It's fine, no rush, think it over well! I'll wait for you to come...

MasteryRequirement.chinese: 你掌握的知识不足，无法使用这个……
MasteryRequirement.english: The knowledge you've mastered isn't enough, you can't use this...

Mastery_newlevel.chinese: 你的领悟达到了新的境界……
Mastery_newlevel.english: Your comprehension has reached a new realm...

Mining_Mastery.chinese: 产宝石的岩石产量翻倍了。
Mining_Mastery.english: The output of gem-producing rocks has doubled.

MysteryBoxAnnounce.chinese: 现在可以找到谜之盒了……
MysteryBoxAnnounce.english: Mystery boxes can now be found...

NewIdeas.chinese: 你有些事情想在今天结束的时候考虑一下……
NewIdeas.english: There are some things you want to think over at the end of today...

Pam_busSign.chinese: 年轻人，我去参加节日了！你自己开车吧。——潘姆
Pam_busSign.english: Young one, I went to the festival! Drive yourself. —Pam

Pam_busSign_generic.chinese: 年轻人，我今天休息！你自己开车吧。——潘姆
Pam_busSign_generic.english: Young one, I'm resting today! Drive yourself. —Pam

Pam_busSign_resort.chinese: 我今天去度假了！你自己开车吧。——潘姆
Pam_busSign_resort.english: I went on vacation today! Drive yourself. —Pam

ParrotEgg_Description.chinese: 召唤一只跟随你的 {0} 级鹦鹉，使得杀怪时有{1}概率掉落金币。
ParrotEgg_Description.english: Summons one level {0} parrot that follows you, making it so that killing monsters has a {1} chance to drop gold coins.

PastaPrimavera_Description.chinese: 放了新鲜蔬菜，裹满奶油酱的意面。
PastaPrimavera_Description.english: Pasta with fresh vegetables added, wrapped all over in cream sauce.

PowdermelonSoda_Description.chinese: 蕴含瓜皮的力量，会自然起泡。
PowdermelonSoda_Description.english: Contains the power of the melon rind, and naturally fizzes.

QiSummitCheat.chinese: 哟呵……山顶冒出了一位贵客呀。#$b#你是不是觉得自己特聪明？#$b#你肯定在想，作个弊看看有什么好东西吧。#$b#你这种人，眼里只有你自己。#$b#真是卑鄙。
QiSummitCheat.english: Well well... a distinguished guest has popped up on the summit. Do you think you're especially clever? You're surely thinking, let's cheat a bit and see what good stuff there is. People like you only have yourselves in your eyes. Truly despicable.

QoS_Cookbook.chinese: 你学习了 {0} 个新食谱。

RaccoonFinal.chinese: 你的新邻居过得很滋润！
RaccoonFinal.english: Your new neighbors are living very comfortably!

Raccoon_busy.chinese: 另一个玩家正在和浣熊交谈。
Raccoon_busy.english: Another player is talking with the raccoon.

Raccoon_expanded.english: The raccoon shop has now been expanded.

Raccoon_interim.chinese: 浣熊：波波，我们过得很好……
Raccoon_interim.english: Raccoon: Bobo, we are living very well...

Raccoon_interim_1.chinese: 浣熊：好了，我或许能找到老婆……
Raccoon_interim_1.english: Raccoon: Alright, maybe I can find a wife...

Raccoon_interim_2.chinese: 浣熊：我们可以组建家庭了……
Raccoon_interim_2.english: Raccoon: We can start a family now...

Raccoon_interim_3.chinese: 浣熊：我们可以迎接新的家庭成员了……
Raccoon_interim_3.english: Raccoon: We can welcome new family members now...

Raccoon_interim_4.chinese: 浣熊：波波，你真是我的好朋友。我们家可以再有一个了……
Raccoon_interim_4.english: Raccoon: Bobo, you are truly my good friend. Our family can have one more...

Raccoon_interim_5.chinese: 浣熊：波波，我们现在很幸福了……
Raccoon_interim_5.english: Raccoon: Bobo, we are very happy now...

Raccoon_intro.chinese: 浣熊：帮帮我们，我会给你好东西。
Raccoon_intro.english: Raccoon: Help us, and I'll give you good stuff.

Raccoon_intro_0.english: Raccoon: Hungry... want to eat fish...

Raccoon_intro_1.english: Raccoon: Hungry... want to eat fruit...

Raccoon_intro_2.english: Raccoon: Hungry... want to eat mushrooms...

Raccoon_intro_3.english: Raccoon: Thirsty... want to drink vegetable juice...

Raccoon_intro_4.chinese: 浣熊：哎……波波。我想送老婆一个礼物。
Raccoon_intro_4.english: Raccoon: Hey... bobo. I want to give my wife a present.

Raccoon_receive.chinese: 浣熊：波波，谢谢你。给你这个……
Raccoon_receive.english: Raccoon: Bobo, thank you. Here's this for you...

Race_Begin.english: The next race is about to begin...

Race_Close.chinese: 今天的比赛到此结束。我们明天见！
Race_Close.english: Today's races end here. See you tomorrow!

Race_Close_LastDay.chinese: 今年的比赛到此结束！下回再见！
Race_Close_LastDay.english: This year's races end here! See you next time!

Race_Closed.chinese: 比赛播报员：选手们需要准备一会儿……稍后再来吧！
Race_Closed.english: Race announcer: The contestants need to prepare for a bit... come again later!

Race_Collect_Prize.chinese: 比赛播报员：恭喜！这是你的奖励！
Race_Collect_Prize.english: Race announcer: Congratulations! This is your reward!

Race_Collect_Prize_Special.chinese: 比赛播报员：闪电蜗牛……怎么可能？？呃……行吧，这是你的大奖……
Race_Collect_Prize_Special.english: Race announcer: Lightning Snail... how is that possible?? Uh... fine, this is your grand prize...

Race_Comment_3.english: Speed like this is truly rare!

Race_Comment_4.english: Who takes the prize is about to be revealed...

Race_Ended.chinese: 比赛播报员：今天的比赛已经结束了，希望你看得开心！
Race_Ended.english: Race announcer: Today's races have already ended, hope you enjoyed watching!

Race_Guess.chinese: 比赛播报员：你觉得谁会获胜？
Race_Guess.english: Race announcer: Who do you think will win?

Race_Guess_Already_Made.chinese: 比赛播报员：{0}能否获胜，让我们拭目以待！
Race_Guess_Already_Made.english: Race announcer: Whether {0} can win, let's wait and see!

Race_Guess_Made.chinese: 比赛播报员：你选{0}？好的。现在坐下来欣赏比赛吧！
Race_Guess_Made.english: Race announcer: You pick {0}? OK. Now sit down and enjoy the race!

Race_Late_Guess.chinese: 比赛播报员：比赛好像已经开始了，稍后再来试试吧！
Race_Late_Guess.english: Race announcer: The race seems to have already started, come try again later!

Race_Ongoing.chinese: 比赛播报员：比赛正在进行中！等会儿再说……
Race_Ongoing.english: Race announcer: The race is in progress! Let's talk in a while...

Race_Question.chinese: 比赛播报员：猜猜谁会获胜，猜对即可获得大奖！
Race_Question.english: Race announcer: Guess who will win, guess right and you get a grand prize!

Race_Winner.english: The champion of this race is...

Renovation_AddAttic.chinese: 修建阁楼/增加一处楼梯，通向顶部的房间。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_AddAttic.english: Build attic / Add a staircase leading to a room at the top. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_AddCubby.chinese: 修建凹间/在大门旁边增加一个小凹间。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_AddCubby.english: Build alcove / Add a small alcove beside the front door. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_AddDiningRoom.english: Build dining room / Add a big room to the left of the kitchen. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_AddExtendedCornerRoom.chinese: 扩大角落房间/将角落房间扩建成一片宽敞的空间。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_AddExtendedCornerRoom.english: Enlarge corner room / Extend the corner room into a spacious area. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_CloseDiningRoom.chinese: 隔开餐厅/恢复餐厅和厨房之间的隔墙。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_CloseDiningRoom.english: Partition dining room / Restore the partition wall between the dining room and kitchen. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_OpenDiningRoom.chinese: 打通餐厅/拆除餐厅和厨房之间的隔墙。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_OpenDiningRoom.english: Open up dining room / Tear down the partition wall between the dining room and kitchen. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_RemoveAttic.chinese: 拆除阁楼/将阁楼拆除。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_RemoveAttic.english: Remove attic / Tear down the attic. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_RemoveCubby.chinese: 拆除凹间/拆除大门旁边的小凹间。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_RemoveCubby.english: Remove alcove / Remove the small alcove beside the front door. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_RemoveDiningRoom.chinese: 拆除餐厅/拆除厨房左边的大房间。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_RemoveDiningRoom.english: Remove dining room / Remove the big room to the left of the kitchen. / Choose the renovation area.

Renovation_RemoveExtendedCornerRoom.chinese: 缩小角落房间/将角落房间恢复到原来的大小。/选择装修区域。
Renovation_RemoveExtendedCornerRoom.english: Shrink corner room / Restore the corner room to its original size. / Choose the renovation area.

RetroCatalogueDescription.chinese: 来自过往时代的独特家具套装。
RetroCatalogueDescription.english: A unique furniture set from a bygone era.

RiverlandsFarmPerk.english: At the start you have one fish smoker.

Scholar_Closed.chinese: 学者：朋友，实在抱歉，等节日开始之后我才能和你交流。
Scholar_Closed.english: Scholar: Friend, I'm truly sorry, only after the festival starts can I talk with you.

Scholar_DoneThisYear.chinese: 学者：朋友，希望这些三花蛋对你有用。明年我会再来给你出难题。
Scholar_DoneThisYear.english: Scholar: Friend, I hope these calico eggs are useful to you. Next year I'll come again to set you a hard question.

Scholar_Failed.chinese: 学者：……朋友，很抱歉，你只能下次再来了。
Scholar_Failed.english: Scholar: ...Friend, I'm very sorry, you can only come again next time.

Scholar_Intro.chinese: 学者：朋友，你好！想来一次知识测试吗？如果你能正确回答我的问题，我就给你奖品，怎么样？
Scholar_Intro.english: Scholar: Hello, friend! Want to take a knowledge test? If you can correctly answer my questions, I'll give you a prize, how about it?

Scholar_Intro2.chinese: 学者：太好了！来，请听第一个问题……
Scholar_Intro2.english: Scholar: Great! Come, please listen to the first question...

Scholar_Question_0_0.chinese: 问题 1：鹈鹕镇的{0}是谁在经营？
Scholar_Question_0_0.english: Question 1: Who is running Pelican Town's {0}?

Scholar_Question_0_0_Answers.chinese: 克林特,冈瑟,格斯,威利,玛妮,皮埃尔,罗宾,马龙
Scholar_Question_0_0_Answers.english: Clint, Gunther, Gus, Willy, Marnie, Pierre, Robin, Marlon

Scholar_Question_0_0_Options.chinese: 铁匠铺,博物馆,酒吧,鱼店,动物商店,杂货店
Scholar_Question_0_0_Options.english: Blacksmith shop, museum, bar, fish shop, animal shop, general store

Scholar_Question_0_1.chinese: 问题 1：季节的最后一天是几号？
Scholar_Question_0_1.english: Question 1: What date is the last day of the season?

Scholar_Question_0_2.chinese: 问题 1：我们现在在什么地方？
Scholar_Question_0_2.english: Question 1: What place are we in now?

Scholar_Question_0_2_Answers.chinese: 卡利科沙漠,科利卡沙漠,卡科利沙漠,利科卡沙漠,科卡利沙漠,利卡科沙漠,卡塔科沙漠,卡拉科沙漠,骷髅洞穴沙漠
Scholar_Question_0_2_Answers.english: Calico Desert, Colica Desert, Cacoli Desert, Licoca Desert, Cocali Desert, Licaco Desert, Catacoa Desert, Calaco Desert, Skull Cavern Desert

Scholar_Question_1_0.english: Question 2: In which season does {0} grow?

Scholar_Question_1_1.english: Question 2: When does the {0} tree bear fruit?

Scholar_Question_1_2.chinese: 问题 2：皮埃尔的商店一般哪天不开门？
Scholar_Question_1_2.english: Question 2: On which day is Pierre's shop usually not open?

Scholar_Question_1_2_Answers.chinese: 星期三,星期四,星期二,星期一,星期六,星期日,星期五
Scholar_Question_1_2_Answers.english: Wednesday, Thursday, Tuesday, Monday, Saturday, Sunday, Friday

Scholar_Question_2_0.chinese: 问题 3：你可以在哪个季节钓到{0}？
Scholar_Question_2_0.english: Question 3: In which season can you catch {0}?

Scholar_Question_2_0_Answers.chinese: 一年四季,夏季,秋季,冬季
Scholar_Question_2_0_Answers.english: All year round, summer, autumn, winter

Scholar_Question_2_1.chinese: 问题 3：你一共走了多少步？
Scholar_Question_2_1.english: Question 3: How many steps have you walked in total?

Scholar_Question_2_2.english: Question 3: What is the selling price of {0}?

Scholar_Question_2_2_Answers.english: 800 gold, 1500 gold, 16000 gold, 8000 gold, 1200 gold, 11000 gold, 7500 gold

Scholar_Question_3_0_Answers.chinese: 矿井 20 层,矿井 60 层,矿井 100 层,沙滩,下水道,矿井 120 层
Scholar_Question_3_0_Answers.english: Mine floor 20, mine floor 60, mine floor 100, beach, sewer, mine floor 120

Scholar_Question_3_1_Answers.chinese: 莫尔纳,米勒纳,凡尔纳,尼尔森,瓦尔纳

Scholar_Question_3_2.chinese: 问题 4：鹈鹕镇有多少个垃圾桶？
Scholar_Question_3_2.english: Question 4: How many garbage cans does Pelican Town have?

Scholar_Win.chinese: 学者：非常好！朋友，你知识渊博，我很佩服。给你奖品。
Scholar_Win.english: Scholar: Very good! Friend, your knowledge is vast, I really admire it. Here's your prize.

Scholar_Wrong.chinese: 学者：错了！……朋友，很抱歉，你只能下次再来了。
Scholar_Wrong.english: Scholar: Wrong! ...Friend, I'm very sorry, you can only come again next time.

Shady_Guy.chinese: 可疑的家伙：只要花 1 个卡利科三花蛋。这点“好处费”简直是白菜价。
Shady_Guy.english: Suspicious guy: It only costs 1 Calico calico egg. This bit of "kickback" is simply a cabbage price.

Shady_Guy_2nd.chinese: 可疑的家伙：要找我“办事”吗？只要花 1 个卡利科三花蛋。
Shady_Guy_2nd.english: Suspicious guy: Looking for me to "handle a job"? It only costs 1 Calico calico egg.

Shady_Guy_Closed.chinese: 可疑的家伙：呃……${小子^小姑娘}$，现在不方便，你晚点再来找我。
Shady_Guy_Closed.english: Suspicious guy: Uh... kid, now isn't convenient, come find me a bit later.

Shady_Guy_Ended.chinese: 可疑的家伙：${小子^小姑娘}$，你来晚了，有比赛的时候再来。
Shady_Guy_Ended.english: Suspicious guy: Kid, you came late, come again when there are races.

Shady_Guy_Intro.chinese: 可疑的家伙：喂，${小子^小姑娘}$，你看比赛了没？刺不刺激？
Shady_Guy_Intro.english: Suspicious guy: Hey, kid, have you watched the races or not? Exciting or not?

Shady_Guy_Intro_2.chinese: 可疑的家伙：……是这样，我这有一个小小的“提案”。
Shady_Guy_Intro_2.english: Suspicious guy: ...It's like this, I have a little "proposal" here.

Shady_Guy_Intro_3.chinese: 可疑的家伙：你选一个参赛选手，它下场比赛保准会栽个大跟头……懂我意思不？
Shady_Guy_Intro_3.english: Suspicious guy: You pick a contestant, and in its next race it's guaranteed to take a big fall... get what I mean?

Shady_Guy_Late.chinese: 可疑的家伙：太晚了，比赛已经开始了。等会儿再聊……
Shady_Guy_Late.english: Suspicious guy: Too late, the race has already started. Let's chat in a while...

Shady_Guy_NoEgg.chinese: 可疑的家伙：${小子^小姑娘}$，你好像压根没有卡利科三花蛋。别浪费我时间。
Shady_Guy_NoEgg.english: Suspicious guy: Kid, it seems you don't have any Calico calico eggs at all. Don't waste my time.

Shady_Guy_Ongoing.chinese: 可疑的家伙：${小子^小姑娘}$，现在专注看比赛！之后再聊……
Shady_Guy_Ongoing.english: Suspicious guy: Kid, focus on watching the race now! Chat later...

Shady_Guy_Question.chinese: 可疑的家伙：行了，你选哪个选手当倒霉蛋？
Shady_Guy_Question.english: Suspicious guy: Alright, which contestant do you pick to be the unlucky one?

Shady_Guy_Selected_1.chinese: 可疑的家伙：你选{0}？保证完成任务。
Shady_Guy_Selected_1.english: Suspicious guy: You pick {0}? Guaranteed to complete the job.

Shady_Guy_Selected_2.chinese: 可疑的家伙：你选{0}是吧。等我打个电话……
Shady_Guy_Selected_2.english: Suspicious guy: You pick {0}, right. Wait while I make a phone call...

Shady_Guy_Selected_3.chinese: 可疑的家伙：要选{0}？没问题，没问题……${小子^小姑娘}$，祝你好运。
Shady_Guy_Selected_3.english: Suspicious guy: You want to pick {0}? No problem, no problem... Kid, I wish you good luck.

Shop_Abigail.chinese: 哎，我从衣柜里随便拿了些东西，有没有你想要的？
Shop_Abigail.english: Hey, I casually took some things from the wardrobe, is there anything you want?

Shop_Alex.english: Hey, do you have calico eggs on hand?

Shop_Caroline.chinese: 你好啊，看看有没有你喜欢的东西。
Shop_Caroline.english: Hello, see if there's anything you like.

Shop_Demetrius.chinese: 你手里有三花蛋可以交换吗？我在研究蛋壳的成分。
Shop_Demetrius.english: Do you have calico eggs on hand to exchange? I'm researching the composition of eggshells.

Shop_Elliott.chinese: 我在海滩上捡到了一些有趣的东西，要不要交换？
Shop_Elliott.english: I picked up some interesting things on the beach, want to exchange?

Shop_Emily.chinese: 啊，在阴凉的地方感觉真舒服。
Shop_Emily.english: Ah, it feels really comfortable in a shady place.

Shop_Evelyn.chinese: 亲爱的，慢慢看吧，我今天一天都待在这里！
Shop_Evelyn.english: Dear, take your time looking, I'm staying here all day today!

Shop_George.chinese: 我把值得卖的东西都拿出来了。
Shop_George.english: I've taken out all the things worth selling.

Shop_Haley.chinese: 你要不要再多弄一些三花蛋？那样就可以把我的东西全买走了！
Shop_Haley.english: Do you want to get some more calico eggs? Then you could buy all my stuff!

Shop_Harvey.chinese: 唔……这是我做的飞机模型……你喜欢吗？
Shop_Harvey.english: Um... these are airplane models I made... do you like them?

Shop_Jodi.chinese: 今年的货不是很好，不好意思……
Shop_Jodi.english: This year's goods aren't very good, sorry...

Shop_Kent.chinese: 哎，我有几样东西要卖，你看看有没有感兴趣的。
Shop_Kent.english: Hey, I have a few things to sell, see if there's anything you're interested in.

Shop_Leah.chinese: 我手里多了一些木板，所以做了这些迷你书架……
Shop_Leah.english: I had some extra wooden boards, so I made these mini bookshelves...

Shop_Leo.chinese: 能给我一些三花蛋吗？我想放到我的窝里。
Shop_Leo.english: Can you give me some calico eggs? I want to put them in my nest.

Shop_Marnie.chinese: 我家里多了一卷墙纸，20 个三花蛋卖给你！
Shop_Marnie.english: My house had an extra roll of wallpaper, I'll sell it to you for 20 calico eggs!

Shop_Pam.chinese: 嘿嘿嘿……我在冰箱深处找到了一些放久了的喝的。
Shop_Pam.english: Heh heh heh... I found some drinks that had been kept too long deep in the fridge.

Shop_Penny.chinese: 嗨！希望这里有你喜欢的东西。
Shop_Penny.english: Hi! I hope there's something you like here.

Shop_Pierre.chinese: 嘘……我这可以用现金买三花蛋！嘿嘿……别跟刘易斯说啊。
Shop_Pierre.english: Shh... here you can buy calico eggs with cash! Heh heh... don't tell Lewis, OK.

Shop_Robin.chinese: 哎，快看看我自己的做的这张墙纸，要买吗？
Shop_Robin.english: Hey, quickly look at this wallpaper I made myself, want to buy it?

Shop_Sam.chinese: 我的破滑板你要吗？说不定可以用来当装饰。
Shop_Sam.english: Do you want my broken skateboard? Maybe it could be used as decoration.

Shop_Sebastian.chinese: 我在湖边找到了一些东西。
Shop_Sebastian.english: I found some things by the lake.

Shop_Shane.chinese: 我在冷冻室里找到了一些吃的，便宜卖给你，不过别看保质期。
Shop_Shane.english: I found some food in the freezer, I'll sell it to you cheap, but don't look at the expiry date.

Shop_Vincent.chinese: 嗨！呃……我翻出来了一些东西，想买吗？！
Shop_Vincent.english: Hi! Uh... I dug out some things, want to buy?!

SkillBookMessage.chinese: 你学到了一些{0}方面的知识。

SkullCaveKickWarning.chinese: 将会踢出现在位于骷髅洞穴里的所有玩家，要继续吗？

SpringOnionMastery_Description.chinese: 带叶洋葱的售价提高到了原先的 5 倍。
SpringOnionMastery_Description.english: The selling price of spring onions is raised to 5 times the original.

SquidFestBooth_Explanation.chinese: 这是一场鱿鱼钓鱼挑战！如果你能达到我们的每日钓鱼目标，就可以赢得奖品。请查看左侧的告示牌。我们还在水里放了特殊的鱼饵，让鱿鱼全天都出来活动！
SquidFestBooth_Explanation.english: This is a squid fishing challenge! If you can reach our daily fishing target, you can win prizes. Please check the notice board on the left. We also put special bait in the water, so the squid come out and are active all day!

SquidFestBooth_Intro.chinese: 欢迎来到鱿鱼节！您有什么事？
SquidFestBooth_Intro.english: Welcome to the squid festival! What business do you (polite) have?

SquidFestBooth_NoRewards.chinese: 你还没有赢得奖品，赶紧开始钓鱿鱼吧！
SquidFestBooth_NoRewards.english: You haven't won a prize yet, hurry and start catching squid!

SquidFestSign.chinese: [textcolor black][letterbg LooseSprites\\squidFestLetterBG 0]             ——— 鱿鱼节 ———^^12 日（星期五）至 13 日（星期六）。^^为期两天的鱿鱼钓鱼盛宴。如果你能达到我们的每日钓鱼目标，就可以赢得奖品。^^（注意：在此标志附近发现的个人物品将送至失物招领处）
SquidFestSign.english: --- Squid Festival --- The 12th (Friday) to the 13th (Saturday). A two-day squid fishing feast. If you can reach our daily fishing target, you can win prizes. (Note: personal items found near this sign will be sent to the lost and found)

SquidFest_AlreadyGotAvailableRewards.chinese: 目前没有可以获取的奖励了，继续钓更多鱿鱼吧！
SquidFest_AlreadyGotAvailableRewards.english: At present there are no rewards you can get, keep catching more squid!

SquidFest_GotAllRewardsToday.chinese: 恭喜！你达到了我们的铱星目标，赢得了今天所有的奖励。
SquidFest_GotAllRewardsToday.english: Congratulations! You reached our iridium-star target and won all of today's rewards.

SquidFest_Pam.chinese: 我没有钓鱿鱼的本事，不过没关系，我会在这里为你加油的。
SquidFest_Pam.english: I don't have the skill to catch squid, but it doesn't matter, I'll cheer for you here.

SquidFest_Willy.chinese: 钓多了你就会了解鱿鱼的习性，眼睛还没看到你就能感觉到有一只上钩了。
SquidFest_Willy.english: Once you fish a lot you'll understand the squid's habits, before your eyes even see it you can feel that one is on the hook.

TroutDerby_NowOpen.english: The once-a-year trout competition has started.

Willy_Challenge_Description_1.chinese: 威利提出挑战，要你钓 3 条沙鱼。
Willy_Challenge_Description_1.english: Willy issues a challenge, wanting you to catch 3 sandfish.

Willy_Challenge_Description_2.chinese: 威利提出挑战，要你钓一条蝎鲤鱼。
Willy_Challenge_Description_2.english: Willy issues a challenge, wanting you to catch one scorpion carp.

Willy_Challenge_Description_3.chinese: 威利提出挑战，要你找到“黄金浮漂”。
Willy_Challenge_Description_3.english: Willy issues a challenge, wanting you to find the "golden bobber".

Willy_Challenge_Return_1.chinese: 啊，你钓到了。钓的时候是不是很刺激？#$b#给你奖励，25 个卡利科三花蛋。
Willy_Challenge_Return_1.english: Ah, you caught them. Was it really exciting while fishing? Here's your reward, 25 Calico calico eggs.

Willy_Challenge_Return_2.chinese: 啊，你成功了。还挺难钓的吧，你觉得呢？#$b#给你奖励，50 个卡利科三花蛋。
Willy_Challenge_Return_2.english: Ah, you succeeded. It was pretty hard to catch, don't you think? Here's your reward, 50 Calico calico eggs.

Willy_Challenge_Return_3.chinese: 嗯，这不是我最喜欢的黄金浮漂吗！#$b#就是有股鱼腥味……嘿嘿。$h#$b#给你奖励，30 个卡利科三花蛋。
Willy_Challenge_Return_3.english: Hm, isn't this my favorite golden bobber! It just has a fishy smell... heh heh. Here's your reward, 30 Calico calico eggs.

Willy_DesertFishing1.chinese: 威利的挑战：钓 3 条沙鱼。

Willy_DesertFishing2.chinese: 威利的挑战：钓一条蝎鲤鱼。
Willy_DesertFishing2.english: Willy's challenge: catch one scorpion carp.

Willy_DesertFishing3.chinese: 威利：有条鱼吞了我宝贝的黄金浮漂！谁能找到就给他 30 个蛋。
Willy_DesertFishing3.english: Willy: A fish swallowed my precious golden bobber! Whoever can find it, I'll give them 30 eggs.

Willy_GoldenBobber.chinese: 找到并归还威利的黄金浮漂。
Willy_GoldenBobber.english: Find and return Willy's golden bobber.

WizardCatalogueLetter.english: My ex-wife took all the furniture away. Luckily I had foresight, and made phantom backups of everything, recorded in this book. I hope you like it. -- M. Rasmodius
